comment: Material is pretty common sense and there is a lot of busy work, but New is a nice guy and truly cares about the class. Overall the grading is easy, but there is a lot of work.

Boring material but New is an interesting guy. Fairly easy grader although he gives a ton of busy work. Brings in a lot of guest speakers to liven up the class. A very caring professor who tries to connect with every student.
Overall this is an okay class. Dr. New is a nice guy. He listens to students and is responsive to feedback. He's not too hard of a grader either.

A lot of busy work but it helps you understand the material.  Can cram the night before and do moderately well.  Big group project, daily homework assignments, and 3 small tests.  Most of the work is done outside of class.  This is a perfect class for the person that tries hard but never seems to do as well as they want.

He is really a very good professor with interesting things to say about the business world. The busywork is like 30 minutes per night, twice a week, so not a big deal. You take tests both by yourself and then with a group, so you really shouldn't average less than a B, and it's not hard to get an A. Projects do take a decent amount of time
Classes with him are never ending of tedious work.  He expects you to memorize the text.  I would never take him again. The worst class I ever took!!!!

His class is a lot of fun, and while there is some busy work he acknowledges it and tries to make it light.  Overall, without the busy work I probably would not have opened up the book prior to the night before a test.  Great professor!

Organizational Behavior with New becomes a never-ending deluge of busywork. His does NOT teach the tests. They are taken from the book, which you have to MEMORIZE COMPLETELY to get a B on the tests. Luckily, the biggest part of your grade is the group project. Hope you don't get stuck with morons for a team. Hope that you are a good team player.

Oh Randolph, what a great professor you are.  Professor New is a great professor because he's passionate about what he does despite the fact that most students think OB is a joke.  The course required way too much busy work and often times seemed like a gigantic waste of my time, but in the end the LT projects were rewarding.
amazing professor; really looking to help you find your place in all of the material (which there is a lot of); class is very organized, and expectations are clear; lots of busy work, but it's useful
Learned a lot in the class, and got a lot out of it, but there is a ton of material to keep up with.  The work was not very difficult, but there was a lot of it.
new is a great man, and i would take him again..the only problem is that he has to teach a****ty class...OB sucks
One of the worst professors.  Creates busywork, tests are not on what you learn in class.  Loves nitpicky test questions, but the class is about big ideas.
